moments.title: Paul Simon turns 85
moments.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Paul Simon, half of the iconic duo Simon & Garfunkel and a celebrated solo artist, celebrates his 85th birthday this week.

angles.name: Folk Icon
angles.copy: Happy 85th to Paul Simon! From 'The Sound of Silence' to 'Graceland', his songwriting is unmatched. What's your go-to Simon track?

angles.name: Graceland Legacy
angles.copy: Paul Simon turns 85 tomorrow! Still sounds fresh decades later. That 'Graceland' album changed everything, didn't it?

moments.title: Usher celebrates 48th birthday
moments.blurb: Multi-platinum R&B superstar Usher, known for hits like 'Yeah!' and 'Confessions', marks his 48th birthday this Wednesday.

angles.name: R&B King
angles.copy: Happy 48th Birthday to the one and only Usher! Still bringing the smooth moves and even smoother vocals. What's your favourite Usher jam?

angles.name: Confessions Era
angles.copy: Usher turns 48 this week! Remember when 'Confessions' dropped and changed the game? Absolute bangers from start to finish.

moments.title: John Mayer turns 49
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning guitarist and singer-songwriter John Mayer, celebrated for his blues-infused rock and pop, will be 49 on Friday.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Big birthday for John Mayer this Friday, he turns 49! The man's a guitar wizard. What's your favourite Mayer riff?

angles.name: Room for Squares
angles.copy: John Mayer is 49 on Friday. From 'Your Body Is a Wonderland' to his bluesier work, he's just kept getting better. What's his best album?

moments.title: Flea (RHCP) celebrates 64th birthday
moments.blurb: Michael 'Flea' Balzary, the energetic bassist and co-founder of the Red Hot Chili Peppers, turns 64 on Friday.

angles.name: Funk Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 64th to Flea from Red Hot Chili Peppers this Friday! The man's a force of nature on bass. What's your favourite RHCP track?

angles.name: Slap Bass King
angles.copy: Flea turns 64 on Friday! His bass lines are iconic and his stage presence is electric. Name a more influential rock bassist, we'll wait...

moments.title: Eminem turns 54
moments.blurb: Rap icon Eminem, known for his groundbreaking albums and lyrical prowess, celebrates his 54th birthday on Saturday.

source.l: Facebook - THE RAP LEGEND IS ABOUT TO TURN 54!

angles.name: Rap God
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Eminem this Saturday! Still dropping lyrical fire after all these years. What's his greatest track?

angles.name: Slim Shady Legacy
angles.copy: Eminem turns 54 on Saturday! From Slim Shady to Marshall Mathers, his impact on music is undeniable. Which era of Em is your favourite?

moments.title: Wyclef Jean celebrates 57th birthday
moments.blurb: Haitian-American musician, producer, and Fugees co-founder Wyclef Jean will be 57 on Saturday.

angles.name: Fugees Legend
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to the incredible Wyclef Jean this Saturday! From The Fugees to his solo career, a true musical visionary. What's your favourite Wyclef moment?

angles.name: Carnival Vibes
angles.copy: Wyclef Jean turns 57 on Saturday! The man behind 'The Carnival' and countless hits. Get those weekend vibes going with some Wyclef!

moments.title: Ne-Yo turns 47

angles.name: R&B Smoothness
angles.copy: Happy 47th Birthday to Ne-Yo this Sunday! Still bringing that signature R&B smoothness. What's your favourite Ne-Yo track?

angles.name: So Sick
angles.copy: Ne-Yo turns 47 on Sunday! From 'So Sick' to writing for Beyoncé, he's a true talent. Which of his hits is still on your playlist?

moments.title: Shaggy celebrates 58th birthday
moments.blurb: Reggae fusion superstar Shaggy, famous for global hits like 'It Wasn't Me' and 'Boombastic', turns 58 this week.

angles.name: Mr Lover Lover
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the one and only Shaggy this Thursday! Still bringing the good vibes and reggae fusion. What's your favourite Shaggy hit?

angles.name: It Wasn't Me
angles.copy: Shaggy turns 58 this week! You can't hear 'It Wasn't Me' without singing along, can you? Timeless tunes from a legend.
